---
title: "GitHub"
description: "Use GitHub for code, documentation, collaboration, and canonical subproject repositories."
---

GeoEpi generally uses [GitHub](https://github.com/) for version-controlled code, documentation, issue and review discussions, collaboration, and canonical subproject repositories. The [GeoEpi organization](https://github.com/geoepi) is the normal home for lab-owned subprojects and hosts the operational [GeoEpi Hub](https://github.com/geoepi/geoepi-hub).

Repositories may also live in individual accounts, forks, external upstreams, or collaborator-owned organizations. Identify one canonical working repository for each subproject so the Hub registry and synchronization workflow have one stable source.

GitHub is not a storage system for controlled data, credentials, tokens, or large computational outputs. Use approved storage and computation environments, and link to them from the repository when appropriate.
